change.description: The StabilityLevel field in the Context struct changes from a value type (ValidationStabilityLevel) to a pointer (*ValidationStabilityLevel). Any code that directly assigns a non-pointer ValidationStabilityLevel value to Context.StabilityLevel will fail to compile with a type mismatch. Code that propagates the field from one Context to another (pointer-to-pointer copy) remains valid.

breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Assigning a ValidationStabilityLevel value (non-pointer) to a *ValidationStabilityLevel field is a type mismatch and fails to compile.

impacted_files.suggested_fix: Replace the direct assignment with a pointer: context.StabilityLevel = &ltv.level. Ensure that any subsequent reads of context.StabilityLevel in callers dereference the pointer (e.g., *context.StabilityLevel) or perform a nil check before using the value.
